# 研究报告

Java 虚拟线程在哪个 JDK 版本正式发布，synchronized 导致的线程固定问题在哪个版本改善？引用 JEP。

**结果：** `COMPLETED_WITH_LIMITATIONS`

## 结论汇总

| 研究对象 | 正式发布 JDK 版本 | JEP 编号与正式名称 | JEP Status 与 Release 字段 | 预览版本历史 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Java 虚拟线程 | Virtual threads, which were introduced in [Java 21](https://openjdk.org/projects… | The JVM's implementation of the `synchronized` keyword should allow a virtual th… | 证据冲突 | Virtual threads were previously introduced in preview JEPs in both Java 19 and J… |
| synchronized pinning 改善 | 在 Java 21 中引入了虚拟线程（Virtual Threads），虚拟线程是 JDK 提供的轻量级线程（lightweight threads）实现，由 … | JDK 24 的 [JEP 491](https://openjdk.org/jeps/491) 改进了这一点，使虚拟线程在 `synchronized` 中阻… | JDK 24 的 [JEP 491](https://openjdk.org/jeps/491) 改进了这一点，使虚拟线程在 `synchronized` 中阻… | * **JDK 19 (*JEP 425*):** First preview, experimental APIs. |

## 已验证结论

### Virtual threads were previously introduced in preview JEPs in both Java 19 and Java 20, and they will reach their finalized state in Java 21.

- 研究项：`Java 虚拟线程 · 预览版本历史`
- 候选：`e67c1cc1-6645-4f47-bba3-e9e2711b0abf`
- Evidence: `evidence:241b8f3e48e4b5fc137de8357e07aa492443e37dea6cff02`
  - Exact quote: “Virtual threads were previously introduced in preview JEPs in both Java 19 and Java 20, and they will reach their finalized state in Java 21.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/034cf884-02df-4db6-9550-eee55afd9517/f2a0c5fb1fb89aaadfd9d6b83b820ce6f9a5d15f52b5d904328c69a41686bb6f`
  - URL: https://blogs.oracle.com/javamagazine/java-21-sneak-peek/

### The JVM's implementation of the \`synchronized\` keyword should allow a virtual thread to unmount when inside a \`synchronized\` method or statement, or when blocked on a monitor.

- 研究项：`Java 虚拟线程 · JEP 编号与正式名称`
- 候选：`9aefb34c-b276-474d-b49b-fba7f9044a7e`
- Evidence: `evidence:6901922ffe2e71e1ad302f7b48d7aa4cb6625af7accc3852`
  - Exact quote: “The JVM's implementation of the \`synchronized\` keyword should allow a virtual thread to unmount when inside a \`synchronized\` method or statement, or when blocked on a monitor.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/26ee9693-2e4b-435a-aef4-e69e59ef4457/fb276e6efefd548d5929dd23c76ef0942b0da35dd6484b14c48e82eed2b49bc9`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/jeps/491

### Virtual threads, which were introduced in [Java 21](https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/21/) via [JEP 444](https://openjdk.org/jeps/444), are lightweight threads that are provided by the JDK rather than the operating system (OS).

- 研究项：`Java 虚拟线程 · 正式发布 JDK 版本`
- 候选：`69bb03a5-a3f6-496c-9572-6dc771f06007`
- Evidence: `evidence:eb632162756108c885e6f470ceb54c8b2f04e5785a2d6c23`
  - Exact quote: “Virtual threads, which were introduced in [Java 21](https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/21/) via [JEP 444](https://openjdk.org/jeps/444), are lightweight threads that are provided by the JDK rather than the operating system (OS).”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/9e3bd945-2349-460b-b249-35912726a9fd/a302c118cb333328b2bdede55362e5c0d8cb9f632d3056bf3b35ad5ba1a9c8e3`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/jeps/491

### * **JDK 19 (*JEP 425*):** First preview, experimental APIs.

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善 · 预览版本历史`
- 候选：`9ce53aa5-5772-4f26-a6a2-33e840fce7ed`
- Evidence: `evidence:52da20e845db4a4239f527a0f2ade708c4fdfd7728890718`
  - Exact quote: “* **JDK 19 (*JEP 425*):** First preview, experimental APIs.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/2a1d3511-cea0-434c-b053-f0a38a0cdd3b/4a0d98804ae6a71d49e90685163ef144350f74b08bf29f84a85b4304379d01bf`
  - URL: https://javapro.io/2026/03/05/java-25-and-the-new-age-of-performance-virtual-threads-and-beyond/

### JDK 24 的 [JEP 491](https://openjdk.org/jeps/491) 改进了这一点，使虚拟线程在 \`synchronized\` 中阻塞时也能释放底层平台线程，消除了绝大多数由 \`synchronized\` 带来的 Pinning 场景。

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善 · JEP Status 与 Release 字段`
- 候选：`286b84a8-f564-43a7-8186-66288d9955b4`
- Evidence: `evidence:6b00a28ec071f9ef653907f58b4e069ae83497b59f4ed029`
  - Exact quote: “JDK 24 的 [JEP 491](https://openjdk.org/jeps/491) 改进了这一点，使虚拟线程在 \`synchronized\` 中阻塞时也能释放底层平台线程，消除了绝大多数由 \`synchronized\` 带来的 Pinning 场景。”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/bc1bd8e0-2d61-4e40-9d95-b688b6281351/a53bb22aecff20ec519ee68102dec7eae7997163da313ba1abe5a3834269f189`
  - URL: https://javaguide.cn/java/concurrent/virtual-thread.html

### JDK 24 的 [JEP 491](https://openjdk.org/jeps/491) 改进了这一点，使虚拟线程在 \`synchronized\` 中阻塞时也能释放底层平台线程，消除了绝大多数由 \`synchronized\` 带来的 Pinning 场景。

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善 · JEP 编号与正式名称`
- 候选：`22cfc1ea-12bf-4298-af2d-52cbd42f3fc2`
- Evidence: `evidence:ef57bbb1fe7e2966805765254a145842aace04d3d882ce39`
  - Exact quote: “JDK 24 的 [JEP 491](https://openjdk.org/jeps/491) 改进了这一点，使虚拟线程在 \`synchronized\` 中阻塞时也能释放底层平台线程，消除了绝大多数由 \`synchronized\` 带来的 Pinning 场景。”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/bc1bd8e0-2d61-4e40-9d95-b688b6281351/a53bb22aecff20ec519ee68102dec7eae7997163da313ba1abe5a3834269f189`
  - URL: https://javaguide.cn/java/concurrent/virtual-thread.html

### 在 Java 21 中引入了虚拟线程（Virtual Threads），虚拟线程是 JDK 提供的轻量级线程（lightweight threads）实现，由 JVM 调度。

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善 · 正式发布 JDK 版本`
- 候选：`ddb8eff6-3401-4ad3-bb34-c3bc34892c46`
- Evidence: `evidence:0747b751e9e3d2c45654bd758ebe63f292a0642384980178`
  - Exact quote: “在 Java 21 中引入了虚拟线程（Virtual Threads），虚拟线程是 JDK 提供的轻量级线程（lightweight threads）实现，由 JVM 调度。”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/22ca9546-b03c-4a25-b47d-93a53fabbe1c/86481c021f02efb4779dd70eb03476c39d67673b2ee4b8f15f4663d900d5a210`
  - URL: https://blog.homurax.com/2024/05/13/virtual-threads/

## 局限与未解决项

- **Java 虚拟线程 · JEP Status 与 Release 字段**：证据冲突且补充检索后仍未解决（`CONFLICT_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED`，`CONFLICT_EXHAUSTED`）
